principalConclusion: ARA is one configurable product with a microsequence-first authoring/composition model. A MicrosequenceRevision is the initial reusable authored unit; a CourseVersion is an immutable, pedagogically complete composition of contextual Placements, structure, dependencies, configuration, provenance and publication policy. Study state belongs to the learner/course-version/placement/card context, not globally to reused content.
acceptedDecisions: Accept MicrosequenceLineage/MicrosequenceRevision as the initial reusable authoring unit, explicitly revisable in future taxonomy/domain versions.
Accept Placement as the contextual occurrence joining a microsequence revision to a course version.
Accept typed RelationEdge and ConceptRef for dependencies/coverage; free-text tags are search aids only.
Accept immutable CourseVersion and PublicationSnapshot; mutable work exists only in authoring workspace state.
Separate ResourceInstance, PracticeDefinition, ResponseDefinition, ValidatorPolicy and FeedbackPolicy.
Accept one base profile + overlays + sparse overrides resolved into EffectiveConfigurationSnapshot.
Integrate Issue #5 research objects as normative optional-profile entities.
Keep personal baseline local/offline/data-minimal without mandatory sync or analytics.
Use workspace-scoped roles and audience-specific publication.
Distinguish reference, copy, fork, adaptation, translation, withdraw, supersede, archive, revoke and delete.
Classify capabilities as core, optional-local, optional-connected, research-experimental, deferred or prohibited.
Require provider-independent import/export and explicit unavailable capability semantics.

qualityConstraints.referenceDevice: Samsung Galaxy A07 class or equivalent modest Android device for first-scope benchmarks
qualityConstraints.offline: baseline study after materialization; deterministic operations remain available
qualityConstraints.MCP: bounded discovery, idempotent writes, expected revision, localized validation/repair
qualityConstraints.accessibility: WCAG 2.2-oriented contracts, assistive alternatives, no rights-disabling profile
qualityConstraints.localization: interface and course language independent; en, pt-BR and pt-PT
qualityConstraints.securityPrivacy: least privilege, purpose binding, confidential workspace controls
qualityConstraints.portability: provider-independent versioned packages and exit path

Issue7: Implement domain ports/adapters without changing entity semantics.
Compare relational metadata + immutable artifacts + local projection against alternatives.
Design revision-based sync with no silent semantic merge.
Define deployment profiles and capability manifests.
Issue8: Design all journeys and state transitions; distinguish placement, revision, publication, reference and fork in user language.
Use progressive disclosure and role-oriented administration.
Issue9: Release-slice core journey from authored microsequence composition to offline study, annotation, repair and republish.
